subject: Demo recap + proposed POC engagement roadmap (PeakRetail)
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Jamal Torres <jamal.torres@peakretail.com>, Priya Sethi <priya.sethi@peakretail.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T14:02:00-08:00
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC engagement roadmap (PeakRetail)

Hi Jamal / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time to walk through PeakRetail’s merchandising use cases this morning. Quick recap + a proposed POC engagement roadmap so we can lock timelines and owners. I’ve attached a short PoC outline and estimated traffic spreadsheet for your review.

Key outcomes from the demo:
- Primary use case: streamlining product attribute enrichment and automatic merchandising copy for category pages.
- Target KPIs discussed: increase conversion on category pages by 5-8%, reduce manual copy time by ~60%.
- Data surface: product catalog + historical search+click logs (no customer PII in scope for the trial).

Proposed POC (4-week, light-touch):
1) Week 0 (prep, 3–5 days): data access + schema sync, SSO link test, synthetic traffic profile confirmation. Owner: PeakRetail ops + Neha (Redwood SE).
2) Week 1 (integration, 5 days): ingest sample catalog, run model on a shadow dataset, validate outputs. Owner: Neha. Deliverable: sample outputs and latency report.
3) Week 2 (evaluation, 7 days): run A/B slice on historical dataset (offline) and collect relevance metrics. Owner: Monica (CS). Deliverable: evaluation dashboard & quality notes.
4) Week 3 (live pilot, 7 days): optional live traffic (low %), monitor latency/cost and business metrics. Owner: PeakRetail + Redwood.
5) Week 4 (wrap & decision): consolidate results, present to stakeholders, decision on expansion or next steps.

Success criteria (proposed):
- Quality: human-rated relevance score >= 4/5 on a 200-sample validation set.
- Performance: p95 latency <= 250ms for the targeted payload under expected concurrency.
- Business: uplift in category CTR or conversion >= 5% in the pilot slice.

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Jamal / Priya: confirm you can provide a 1–3GB sanitized sample catalog + two weeks of search logs for offline evaluation (see sample-traffic-estimates.csv).
- PeakRetail security: confirm SSO type (SAML/OIDC) and any IP allowlist requirements.
- Procurement: if a short-term trial agreement is needed, we’ll share a one-page pilot MSA for review.

Attachments: PR-PoC-outline.pdf (scoped steps), sample-traffic-estimates.csv (traffic & size estimates).

If that looks good I’ll schedule a 30-min technical kickoff with Neha and your engineering lead for early next week.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference — production-grade LLM inference for product teams
From: Jamal Torres <jamal.torres@peakretail.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Priya Sethi <priya.sethi@peakretail.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-06T09:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC engagement roadmap (PeakRetail)

Thanks Michael — this looks helpful and clear. A few quick clarifications from our side before we confirm the kickoff: 

1) Data & scope: we can provide a sanitized catalog and two weeks of logs. We’ll need to scrub any customer identifiers first — is that acceptable for your offline eval?
2) SSO / security: we use Okta (SAML). Our security lead (cc’d below) will need details on access patterns and retention to clear the pilot.
3) Procurement: we prefer a short-term pilot SOW instead of an MSA for speed — can your team provide a one-page SOW + statement of work?

I attached a short doc with some internal questions from engineering and security. Happy to hop on a 30-minute kickoff next Tue or Wed morning (PST).

Best,
Jamal
Director of Product, PeakRetail
jamal.torres@peakretail.com

Attachments: PeakRetail-PoC-questions.docx

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Jamal Torres <jamal.torres@peakretail.com>, Priya Sethi <priya.sethi@peakretail.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@peakretail.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-06T11:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC engagement roadmap (PeakRetail)

Thanks Jamal — great questions. Quick answers and an updated set of owners below.

- Data & sanitization: yes — sanitized catalog + logs are perfect for offline eval. Neha will provide a small ingestion script and a checklist of fields we need (SKU, title, category, attributes). No customer PII required.
- SSO: Okta SAML is supported. Olga (security) will send a short security note outlining retention (default 30 days for logs unless otherwise requested) and options for in-region hosting. If you need stricter retention we can accommodate that for the trial but will note audit implications.
- Pilot agreement: we can produce a one-page pilot SOW + standard short-term clauses. I’ll loop legal if you want any custom NDA/clauses.

Assigned owners / immediate actions:
- PeakRetail: provide sanitized sample catalog + logs (Jamal / Priya) — due by 2026-12-09 to keep the timeline.
- Neha Kapoor (Redwood SE): generate ingestion script + latency/throughput estimate by 2026-12-10.
- Monica Patel (Redwood CS): build evaluation dashboard and sampling rubric by 2026-12-15.
- Olga Petrov (Redwood Security): security note + SSO checklist by 2026-12-08.
- Michael Grant: share pilot SOW and schedule kickoff meeting.

I’ll attach the SOW draft to the drive link and share a proposed 30-min kickoff slot for Tue 12/10 10:00–10:30am PST. If that works I’ll send calendar invites.

Thanks — I’ll also add the sample-traffic-estimates.csv to the Drive.

Regards,
Michael

Appreciate the clear plan, Michael. A couple of notes from security: 
- SSO via Okta is fine; we’ll share metadata and test account details. We need confirmation that log retention can be configured to 14 days for the pilot (we are comfortable with that).
- Network: we prefer to use a secure peering / IP allowlist during the pilot. Can your infra team support a static egress IP?

If you can confirm 14-day retention and provide a static egress IP, we can get the sample dataset to you by EOD 12/09 and lock the kickoff on 12/10.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Security Lead, PeakRetail
